embeds.description:
**10. Security Considerations**

**10.1 Is My Wallet and Private Information Safe?**
- **Decentralized Authentication:** No private key exposure.
- **Data Encryption:** Protects data traffic.
- **No Data Storage:** We don’t store personal info on servers.
- **Best Practices:** Follows industry standards.

*Important:* Never share private keys or seed phrases.

**10.2 How Does TurtleBlunt Token Creator Ensure Smart Contract Security?**
- **Audited Contracts:** Identifies and fixes vulnerabilities.
- **Exact Match Verification:** Confirms deployed contract matches published code.
- **Open Source:** Community can review.
- **Reentrancy Guards:** Via OpenZeppelin’s ReentrancyGuard.

**8. Widget Customization**

Embed your token’s sale widget on external websites.

**8.1 Header Image and Title**
1. **Access Widget Customization:** In the Interactor Page, under "Customize Widget Code".
2. **Include Custom Header Image:** Provide a valid image URL.
3. **Include Custom Title:** Display a custom header/title.

**8.2 Widget Sizing**
- Choose predefined sizes (e.g., 800x800).
- Ensure responsiveness to match your site layout.

**8.3 Generating and Embedding Widget Code**
1. **Generate Widget Code:** Click "Generate Widget Code".
2. **View & Copy:** The DApp provides Widget URL and Iframe code.
3. **Embed on Website:** Paste the iframe into your site’s HTML.
4. **Test Widget:** Verify display and functionality.

```html
<iframe src="YOUR_GENERATED_WIDGET_URL" width="800" height="800" style="border: none;"></iframe>
```

embeds.title: 12. Troubleshooting
embeds.description:
**12. Troubleshooting**

**12.1 I’m Unable to Connect My Wallet**
- Wallet installed? (MetaMask, etc.)
- Correct network selected?
- Use a supported browser (Chrome, Firefox)
- Refresh, clear cache, disable conflicting extensions

**12.2 Transactions Are Failing or Taking Too Long**
- Check gas fees and ETH balance
- Verify transaction status on Etherscan
- Network congestion can cause delays
- Avoid multiple simultaneous transactions

**12.3 Generated Images Not Displaying**
- Verify image URL or IPFS link
- Use supported image formats (PNG/JPEG)
- Ensure reliable hosting, refresh metadata

**12.4 I Can’t Update My Metadata**
- Owner-only functionality
- Check IPFS upload success
- Contract must be verified for full features

**12.5 Widget Code Isn’t Working on My Website**
- Verify complete iframe code
- Check widget URL accessibility
- Some site builders block iframes
- Regenerate code if needed

**12.6 Contract Verification Failure**
- Mismatch between source & bytecode
- Wrong compiler version or optimization settings
- Provide complete source code (imports)
- Manual verification may be required

embeds.title: 6. Interactor Page Overview
embeds.description:
**6. Interactor Page Overview**

The Interactor Page is your central hub for managing and interacting with your created tokens.

**6.1 Connecting to Your Token Contract**
1. **Navigate to Interactor Page:** From the main menu, select "Interactor".
2. **Enter Contract Address:** Input the Ethereum address of your token contract.
3. **Connect:** Click the "Connect" button to load your token’s details.
4. **View Token Details:** Once connected, you’ll see Token Name, Symbol, Total Supply, Decimals, Token Price, and Metadata URL.

**6.2 Managing Token Price**
1. **Locate "Set Token Price":** Enter desired price in ETH.
2. **Confirm Transaction:** Approve the transaction in your wallet.
3. **Price Update:** Reflects in the Token Details upon confirmation.

**6.3 Burning Tokens**
1. **Burn Section:** Specify the number of tokens to burn.
2. **Execute Burn:** Approve the transaction.
3. **Confirm Burn:** Tokens are permanently removed from circulation.

**6.4 Withdrawing ETH**
1. **Locate "Withdraw ETH":** Transfer accumulated ETH from token sales.
2. **Approve Transaction:** Confirm in your wallet.
3. **Completion:** ETH balance in your wallet updates accordingly.

**6.5 Updating Metadata**
1. **Open Metadata Form:** "Create/Update Metadata" button.
2. **Fill Details:** Name, Description, Image URL, Website URL, etc.
3. **Submit & Confirm:** Uploads to IPFS and updates `metaUrl` in the smart contract.

**6.6 Generating Images**
1. **Keywords:** Up to 10 descriptive keywords.
2. **AI-Powered Creation:** Choose your preferred generated image.
3. **Use Selected Image:** Sets it as your token’s metadata image.

**6.7 Previously Generated Images**
- View all past AI images & prompts.
- Select or reuse older images for consistency.

---

**6.8 Advanced Interactor Functions**

If your token supports these features, the Interactor Page offers additional controls:

1. **Setting the Token Supply Cap**  
   - If your token is "Capped," you can set a one-time, irreversible cap.  
   - Only the contract owner can set the cap.

2. **Pausing and Unpausing**  
   - If your token is Pausable, you'll see a "Pause/Unpause" button.  
   - Restricts transfers when paused.  
   - Owner-only function.

3. **Minting Tokens**  
   - If Mintable, specify recipient address and amount to mint.  
   - Owner-only function.  
   - Total Supply updates automatically.

embeds.title: 9. Contract Verification
embeds.description:
**9. Contract Verification**

Boosts transparency and trust among users and investors.

**9.1 What is Contract Verification?**
- Publishing your source code on explorers like Etherscan.

**9.2 How Does TurtleBlunt Token Creator Handle Verification?**
1. **Automatic Verification:** The DApp attempts it upon deployment.
2. **Exact Match Method:** Ensures deployed bytecode = published source code.
3. **Manual Verification:** If auto fails, instructions are provided.
4. **Verification Status:** Displayed on Interactor and Listings Pages.

**9.3 Benefits of Contract Verification**
- **Transparency:** Users can inspect contract code.
- **Security:** Reduces hidden malicious risk.
- **Trust:** Builds confidence with potential investors.

**9.4 Steps to Manually Verify Your Contract**
1. **Access Etherscan:** [https://etherscan.io/](https://etherscan.io/)
2. **Initiate Verification:** "Verify and Publish"
3. **Match Compiler:** E.g., Solidity ^0.8.20
4. **Optimization Settings:** Must match original
5. **Provide Code:** Paste entire source (including imports)
6. **Submit & Confirm:** Complete captcha, wait for verified badge
7. **Success:** Contract shows as "Verified" on Etherscan

*Note:* Exact matching of compiler settings is crucial.
